summary: Devils Peak's L-4 cab on a 10-ft timber tower is dated 1952 by the NHLR (1933 per firelookout.com); it is no longer staffed, open to the public, and its access trail is listed as closed.

facts.design: L-4 cab with catwalk on a 10-ft treated timber tower (NHLR: 1952); firelookout.com describes an 8-ft wooden L-4 cab from 1933
facts.status_note: Decommissioned as a fire lookout and open for public use (Mountaineers, undated); the NHLR 2014 visit report says 'Now inactive'

access.note: Mountaineers and firelookout.com (undated) say it is open for public use; overnight stays are first-come, first-served. The access trail is listed as temporarily closed on the Forest Service trail page (undated copy), and the Sept 16, 2026 fire closure boundary text does not name the trail. Current access is unverified.

visit.trail_note: Cool Creek Trail No. 794 from Cool Creek Trailhead on Still Creek Road (FR 2612); about 8 miles round trip with 3,200 ft of gain. Trail page (undated copy): temporarily closed to public access for landslide and December storm damage.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR says the current L-4 cab on the 10-ft tower was constructed in 1952. Firelookout.com says the 1933 cab (8-ft wooden L-4) is the present one. The brief's 1952 matches the NHLR. The story reports both.

The NHLR gives the lookout at 4,953 ft (1,510 m), which the brief's elevation_m uses; firelookout.com gives 5045 ft and Mountaineers gives 5,045 ft for the summit. Elevation is not a supported facts key here, so the story does not use a figure.

Mountaineers and firelookout.com (both undated) say the lookout is open to the public. The Forest Service trail page (undated copy) says the Cool Creek trail is closed for December storm damage. The fire closure order (Sept 16 to Dec 31, 2026) does not name the trail in its boundary text. The story reports all three and does not claim the route is open.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the NHLR's 1952 cab date, but firelookout.com calls the 1933 cab the present one. The NHLR and firelookout.com pages are both undated, and the 2014 NHLR visit report is the newest staffing data. Current access is the main open question: the Cool Creek trail page (undated copy) says closed for storm damage, and the Austin and Narrows fire closure (Sept 16 to Dec 31, 2026) boundary text does not name the trail or Still Creek Road; whether it covers this peak was not confirmed. Search snippets said the trail page was updated Jan 5, 2026, and that the Cool Creek trailhead sits in the Zigzag district; neither was read on the page, so neither is used. Search results also included a 1952 date from a photo aggregator, which was not used. No photos added.
